description: This file defines the ConnectClient class for AWS SDK’s Amazon Connect service, including method annotations for various API operations.

classes.name: ConnectClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon Connect service, extending the base AWS client, with method annotations for each API action.

methods.name: activateEvaluationForm
methods.description: Activates an evaluation form in Amazon Connect.

methods.name: associateAnalyticsDataSet
methods.description: Associates a data set with analytics in Amazon Connect.

methods.name: associateApprovedOrigin
methods.description: Associates an approved origin with Amazon Connect instance.

methods.name: createEvaluationForm
methods.description: Creates a new evaluation form in Amazon Connect.

methods.name: deleteAttachedFile
methods.description: Deletes an attached file from Amazon Connect.

methods.name: describeAgentStatus
methods.description: Describes the status of an agent in Amazon Connect.
